The current weather is refreshed every 1 hour (or 3, 6, 12 hours by changing the settings) and the rain information is refreshed every 4 hours, in order to save battery life. Information displayed may therefore be different from actual conditions.
Thank you for using us. This application uses data from Open Weather Map, Microsoft, NASA and JAXA.

Device information will be sent to our backend services to retrieve weather information. And we share anonymous information with weather providers and business partners to enhance their services.
